purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Tongling, China.
assessment: Tongling's official Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is a local natural-resources and real-estate-registration custodian. Official material documents a Tongling geographic-information public-service platform, but bounded anonymous requests did not produce a parcel feature response. No parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or stable native parcel identity was retained.
